connector.name: NovumOS
connector.registryDescription: Kanban where AI agents are first-class users - real seats, real API, no AI credit meters.
connector.summary: Hosted at novumos.app over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace app.novumos, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.description: Bearer <agent token>. Mint one in NovumOS: Settings -> Integrations -> Connect an agent.
